name: Diff2Flow ODE sampler (diffusion model run as a flow-matching ODE)
plain: Turns an eps- or v-prediction diffusion model (SD-style discrete schedule) into a flow-matching velocity field and integrates it from t=0 (noise) to t=1 (data) with a torchdiffeq solver. Flow time is the rectified ratio √ᾱ/(√ᾱ+√(1−ᾱ)), inverted by interpolation to a fractional diffusion timestep; the flow state is scaled by (√ᾱ+√(1−ᾱ)) before the UNet call, and velocity = predicted x0 − predicted eps. CFG is applied by hand on the velocities. Surprises: the scheduler only sets the step count (fixed-step solvers use evenly spaced t in [0,1]); denoise below 1 raises; the initial noise is divided by σ_0; and the patch registers buffers and methods on the shared base model object in place.
math:
Symbols: ᾱ_k cumulative alphas (with 1 prepended); t flow time; τ diffusion timestep; x flow state.
t(τ) = √ᾱ_τ/(√ᾱ_τ+√(1−ᾱ_τ)); τ(t) by inverse interpolation.
z = x·(√ᾱ_τ+√(1−ᾱ_τ)); eps: x̂0=(z−√(1−ᾱ)ε̂)/√ᾱ; v: x̂0=√ᾱ z−√(1−ᾱ)v̂, ε̂=√ᾱ v̂+√(1−ᾱ) z.
u = x̂0 − ε̂; u_cfg = u_unc + w(u_c − u_unc).
dx/dt = u_cfg, x(0)=noise/σ_0, solve to t=1 (euler, midpoint, rk4, heun3, adams, or adaptive dopri5/8, bosh3, fehlberg2, adaptive_heun).

props.params: solver euler default, steps 20, cfg 5, denoise 1.0 only, scheduler (step count only), log_relative_tolerance −2.5, log_absolute_tolerance −3.5, max_steps 100
props.needs: torchdiffeq; EPS or V_PREDICTION models only
